sent-psyco.html:
Frenzy URGENT

From: vela.skyline@coralia.net
To: psycoone12@hotmail.com
Date: Martes, 11 de octubre de 2005, 00:12
Frenzy está en estado de shock en el Hospital Central. En la madrugada, luego de la fiesta a la que nunca pudo llegar, lo encontraron cerca del edificio unos guardias; está frío y con la mirada perdida. Su corazón late como siempre, pero está... ¡¿en shock?! No está herido, solamente... está frío, ¡no lo entiendo! Es como si algo se le metió, o como si no tuviera algo. De verdad, al inicio cuando me dijeron pensé que era una broma, ojalá hubiera sido así... Me tocó llegar y tomar las llaves en su tapete para buscar sus papeles; solo encontré sus cosas de la universidad y una cédula. ¡No sé qué hacer! No puedo hacer esto sola. Lo único que sé es que me envió este mensaje de voz y... te lo voy a adjuntar. No te asustes, ¿ok? Es tu compañero de trabajo, es nuestro amigo, tú sabes que no está loco. Creo que alguien lo asustó o le hizo algo crítico. O tal vez no debió meterse en ese lugar tan paranormal. Por favor, no me respondas a este mensaje. Y si vas a ayudarme, ve al Hospital Central.
♫ MOVISTAR_VM_05_REC.AMR.mp3

translations.Bienvenido a Project Coralia. Somos el T: Welcome to Project Coralia. We're Team Cheeseovery, a small group trying to recover an old website called Coralia Mail. From what we've been able to reconstruct, it existed between 2005 and 2006 and gradually fell out of use. Its security also seems to have been less than ideal.
translations.Entre los archivos apareció la cuenta de: Among the files, we found an account belonging to a girl named Vela. At first glance, her emails look like those of any young adult. But there's a Movistar audio that doesn't add up, messages that arrive late, and things that change when we reload the page. We don't know if it's all connected. We want to find out without breaking what's left.
translations.La página parece atascada en octubre de: The page seems stuck in October 2005. For now, refreshing is the only way to make progress. If something changes, stay calm… and check twice.
translations.Nota del equipo: alguien volvió a abrir: Team note: someone reopened a file we'd already closed. No one remembers doing it.
translations.Un servicio de correo de 2005. Revisa lo: An email service from 2005. Check the messages and follow the updates.
translations.Registro de códigos descubiertos durante: A record of codes discovered during the investigation.

translations.Fichas incompletas. Algunos nombres no a: Incomplete profiles. Some names don't appear in records after 2006.
translations.El archivo está en desarrollo. Los regis: The archive is still in development. Code, audio, and video records will only be marked complete once Coralia Mail confirms that progress.

translations.Project Coralia es un proyecto narrativo: Project Coralia is a narrative project connecting a contemporary interface with traces of a 2005 website. The experience invites you to explore, observe details, and reconstruct a story through digital archives.
translations.Coralia Mail es una de las piezas centra: Coralia Mail is one of its central pieces: its interface preserves the look of an old email service, while its messages and changing states reveal new layers of the story.
translations.Este sitio funciona como índice y archiv: This site serves as an index and archive. Sections will become available as the experience and its progress system are connected.

Vamos todos en este mundo necesitamos, AMOR, dulce y poderoso AMOR salido de nuestra alma, este te lleva al cielo, no es AMOR del corazón, porque es de seguro ya conseguiste MAMITA, solamente tienes que entrar a mi sitio web y te mostraré cómo ganar el AMOR de 199.7 dólares sin ningún esfuerzo!

¡¡¡OFERTA POR TIEMPO LIMITADO!!! ¡¡¡NO DEJES QUE EL AMOR SE TE ESCAPE!!! [CLICK HERE, VALUED CUSTOMER!]

P.S.: The most attentive customers always find special words hidden across the page and the web. The big prize won't be announced twice!
translations.Coralia ha bloqueado este enlace porque: Coralia has blocked this link because it may be dangerous.

translations.Tu navegador no puede reproducir este au: Your browser cannot play this audio.
translations.Ey, ¿todo bien? Ayer desapareciste rapid: Hey, everything okay? You disappeared so quickly after we saw each other yesterday lol. I was going to send you the group meme, but I think I sent it to everyone except you 💀. Tell me what happened when you get to uni. Oh, and I found the link to that weird site I told you about; I'll send it later.
translations.¿Te llegó lo que te mandé?: Did you get what I sent you?
translations.Oye, te mandé una cosa anoche y no sé si: Hey, I sent you something last night and don't know if it arrived. It's not urgent, but let me know when you can because that file took forever to upload lol.
translations.¿Vas a desayunar?: Are you going to have breakfast?
translations.Vela, te dejé algo preparado por si te l: Vela, I left something ready in case you wake up hungry. Don't leave without eating, okay? You were distracted yesterday and almost forgot to say goodbye. Tell me how it went when you can.
translations.Halloween está a la vuelta de la esquina: Halloween is just around the corner
translations.¿Ya sabes de qué te vas a disfrazar?: Do you know what you're dressing up as yet?
translations.Re: ¿Hacemos algo para Halloween?: Re: Should we do something for Halloween?
translations.Hay ecos que solo se distinguen cuando e: Some echoes can only be distinguished when the glass returns to its place. The fourth reflection will not be like the first.
translations.Buenas tardes. Seguimos pendientes de lo: Good afternoon. We are still waiting for the personal documents for patient Frenzy that were mentioned during the call. Could you bring them in or confirm when they will be available? For now, we only have an incomplete record and cannot finalize the admission.
translations.Vela, contesta cuando despiertes: Vela, reply when you wake up
translations.Holiii, mañana voy a llegar un poco ante: Hiii, I'm getting to university a little early tomorrow. I'll save you a seat like always. Oh, and I found a store with accessories you'd absolutely love lol. I'll send you the address later.
translations.Vela, perdón por escribirte tan tarde. ¿: Vela, sorry for texting so late. Do you have the class notes? I got distracted by the group project and missed half the explanation. I owe you a coffee.
translations.Holaa, ¿me puedes pasar lo que anotaste: Hiii, could you send me what you wrote down in the last class? I got lost when the professor started explaining the assignment and then didn't understand what we had to turn in. I think he said it was due Thursday, but I'm not sure. If you also have the board notes, even better, because the photo I took came out blurry. I owe you one :)
translations.Vela, acuérdate de avisarme cuando llegu: Vela, remember to let me know when you arrive and don't come home alone so late. If you go to the party, keep your phone charged and tell me who you'll be with. I left some food in the fridge in case you're hungry when you get back. And please don't forget your keys; the spare is still in the usual place. Take care.
translations.No sé por qué me dio tanta risa esto, pe: I don't know why this made me laugh so hard, but I had to send it to you. Someone in the group sent it to me and nobody knows who made it first. The image looks awful because it's been forwarded about five times, but look at the bottom corner; it seems like something's written there. Probably a compression error or something silly. Tell me later if you remember where it came from.
translations.Te mando las fotos que tomé en la reunió: I'm sending you the photos I took at the family gathering. Some came out blurry, but a few are nice. I compressed them so they wouldn't be too large; if you want the originals, I'll send them when I get home. Thanks for helping me put everything away at the end. Let me know if you'd like me to print any.
translations.Hola, adjunto los apuntes de hoy. Si alg: Hi, I'm attaching today's notes. If anyone has what the professor explained at the end, could you send it to me? I think he mentioned some pages from the book and an activity for next week, but I was copying the previous part and didn't hear him. Please also check the document date in case I saved it incorrectly. Thanks.
translations.No se puede encontrar el archivo. Es pos: The file cannot be found. It may have been moved or deleted.
translations.Hola. Algunos mensajes antiguos no apare: Hello. Some old messages aren't showing up in my inbox, and I don't remember deleting them. Is there any way to recover them?
translations.Hola, hoy salgo un poco tarde de la univ: Hi, I'll be leaving university a little late today because we were allowed to finish a group activity. I'll call you when I get home, don't worry. I might stop by the store first to buy something for dinner, so if I don't answer right away, that's why. I'll leave the keys where I always do.
translations.Buenos días. Confirmo que asistiré a la: Good morning. I'm confirming that I'll attend Friday's tutoring session. Could you let me know if I should bring the unfinished exercise or if we'll review it during the session? I also wanted to confirm that the time is still 9 a.m. Thank you very much.
translations.RE: RE: Reenvía esto a 10 personas: RE: RE: Forward this to 10 people
translations.Si no reenvías este correo antes de medi: If you don't forward this email before midnight, you'll have seven years of bad luck. If you do, you'll receive an incredible surprise. Don't break the chain!
translations.¿Cansado de esperar mientras carga una p: Tired of waiting for a page to load? Switch to our new ultra-fast connection service today! Limited-time offer.
translations.¡Alexa!, feliz cumpleaños. Espero que te: Alexa! Happy birthday. I hope you have a peaceful, lovely day. I'm not telling you what I bought you yet, but I hope you'll like it. Thanks for looking out for me even when I'm distracted with university. I'll give you your gift when we meet. And save me a piece of cake.
translations.¿Alguien sabe cómo se llama el edificio: Does anyone know the name of the building behind the avenue? The one with the covered windows.
translations.Gracias por preocuparte.\n\nNo hacía fal:
Thanks for worrying about me.

No hacía falta que hablaras tan alto cuando entraste.

— F.
translations.La imagen está dañada. Sin embargo, hay: The image is corrupted. However, something is written in the file metadata:
translations.El registro visual muestra anomalías tér: The visual record shows thermal anomalies and distortion in the subject[cite: 2].
translations.Entidad detectada en sector desconocido: Entity detected in an unknown sector
translations.\n No se quien soy\n:
I don't know who I am
            You know
            Maybe someday
            you'll stop running
            But until then
            you'll give me something of yourself
            And I'll remember you.
